items.statement: Bounded inference about test the molecular contribution of constrained motion to BN-anthracene excitation and charge transfer, separating a local geometry effect from an unsupported aggregate explanation.. All required contrasts and one actual robustness check govern the conclusion; the source claim is not the required answer.
